overview_description.description: MALY is a UAE-based fintech and AI technology company focused on transforming how people manage, save, spend, and access financial services through intelligent digital solutions. Headquartered in Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), the company develops AI-powered financial infrastructure and consumer finance products designed for users across the Middle East and Africa. The platform offers a range of services including digital wallets, smart accounts, virtual and multi-purpose cards, peer-to-peer payments, shared expense management, AI-powered financial guidance, micro-credit solutions, and social savings tools such as ROSCA-based community finance systems. MALY also integrates advanced AI technologies like MalyGPT and AI Money Mentor, which provide personalized financial insights, budgeting assistance, automated savings recommendations, and real-time money management support.
